name: ESP Serial Relay
description: Install, inspect, and remove the ESP serial relay bridge (browser WebSerial → RFC2217 :4001 for esptool, dashboard :4002, tailscale serve :8444).

rfcPort.description: RFC2217 port esptool connects to (rfc2217://…:PORT). Default 4001.

wsPort.description: Web/WS port for the relay GUI + dashboard. Default 4002.

rfcBind.description: RFC2217 bind address. Default 127.0.0.1 (loopback) — widening it exposes the flash port to the network.

browserWait.description: Seconds the daemon waits for the serial tab to (re)connect before dropping flash payload. Default 30.
